description: This file contains a class 'ConfigureKubernetesHostingOptions' which implements various configuration interfaces for setting up Kubernetes-specific hosting options within the Orleans distributed application framework. It handles environment variables, DNS lookups, IP address selection, and namespace reading from a service account.

classes.name: ConfigureKubernetesHostingOptions
classes.description: A class that configures Kubernetes-specific hosting options for Orleans silos. Implements multiple configuration interfaces to set environment-specific parameters and perform post-configuration adjustments, including IP address selection and namespace reading.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures KubernetesHostingOptions, setting namespace, pod name, and pod IP based on environment variables or the host environment.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures ClusterOptions, setting ServiceId and ClusterId from environment variables.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures SiloOptions, setting the silo name from the Kubernetes hosting options.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Post-configuration step to set the advertised IP address and listening endpoints for the silo based on DNS and environment variables.
